notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
Howdy Wranglers!

A couple weeks ago we dropped a major update to the closed alpha. Since then we'd taken feedback from the Closed Alpha Discord server community and made further stabilisations and adjustments. So today we figured we'd drop this post with a collection of all the patch notes that make this new version of Among the Wild what it is. These patch notes basically cover the changes between now and January 2025, or so.

We've also invited a bunch more people into the closed alpha as well! So if you're not already part of the Closed Alpha Discord community, do check the email you got that had the key to the game for your invite link to the discord server and come join the fun!

Lastly, we dropped a new video announcing the keys, but also talking about some of the changes in this update:
[previewyoutube="XEZDtrmrEEI;full"][/previewyoutube]
Without further ado! Patch notes!



Message for newcomers: Consider not looking at these patch notes as they may contain spoilers that could affect your first-time experience. But hey, no hard rules! Do as you wish!

This update will break saves. However if you want to test your old save or the old version of the game we have a separate branch on Steam (Properties->Betas-> ca-0.1 Closed Alpha version 0.1)

We’re gonna keep this list intentionally brief. A detailed breakdown is probably just unnecessary as the TL;DR; is “everything has changed”.

So what have we’ve been up to?

Town

New narrative and refined characters

All new quests 

Mailbox(!)

New pacing of content and progression

Different merchant systems

Town reputation

Moved things around and added new buildings

New Creature Mood System 

New creature traits, abilities and requirements

Creatures communicates needs better (hopefully)

Redesigned creature needs to limit fatigue over time

Fixed a bunch of bugs

New World Building Pipeline

Ability to make more interesting terrain and biomes

Ability to make bigger points of interests

Paths & Rivers

New lighting system

New weather system

New starting farm

Misc:

New tree chopping

New stone cutting

Changes to music system and added some additional music 

New buildables

Fishing Prototype

Cloud saves!

Content / Features:

Additional gate for wooden fences

Added direction hints on gates and doors when building

Added Sell Box to farm

New build menu

Added short fence

Added loom machine and cloth 

Woolys can now remove wool using backscratcher

Trap now uses lure to increase chance of catching different creatures

Added crop status HUD information that shows if watered, fertilized or boosted

Falling trees can now hit other trees

Player can now eat food to replenish health

Complex quests get updated descriptions when steps to continue/complete have changed

Balance:

Big rebalance of the whole game - prices, objectives, rewards and timers

Crops won’t grow without being watered

Crops stays watered for 24h

Water sprinkler does not need additional water anymore

When buying a recipe you get the resources to build as well

Wooly only procreate when happy

Slowed down player

Buffed fertilizer effect

Smoker only accepts seafood

Tweaks:

Showing crop boundaries when looking at crop

Foundation snapping improved

Added SFX when picking up crops

Building in Town is not allowed anymore /Hornbeam

Make stamina bar more noticeable 

You can now water crops from a fence, even from a roof if you would want that

Added “Point” on F to HUD to remind that you can point on things to show creatures what to interact with

Bugs:

Fixed unchoppable small tree

Fixed warp stone bugs

Fixed sorting issue with delivery boxes in tall grass

Tweaks to evolve powder description and function

Water well and clay machine interaction fixes

Fish can now be staffed/hit without insta-dying

“Pick up” prompt is not shown for fishes swimming

Clay Machine now drops remaining dirt on dismantle

Fixed creatures ignoring food even though hungry

Creatures should interact more in general

Fixed collision issue on Slippery Sam’s boat

Fixed fishes trying to strike bobber at the same time

Fixed issues related to saving before arriving at farm

Oak tree is not choppable by regular axe

Duck nest at lake should be easier to reach

Fixed missing phys material in Town Hall for footsteps SFX

Fixed critters being destroyed even though inventory is full when using bug catcher

Improved worm spawning in worm nest

Fixed issues with quality not retaining on save/load for some items

Fixed SFX concurrency issues

Fixed bug where crouching in water could lead to a janky loop

Fixed sleep for creatures

Fixed getting stuck on some dialogs

Fixed various bugs with quests

Fixed Kristians hay bale sample

Fixed issues with Butterflies not spawning

Fixed that objects should not fall through world when loading game

Fixed so that rocks save their broken state instead of disappearing when loading

Crashes:

Integrated intel graphics cards now have low as default, and other integrated cards has medium as default, this is to try to combat crash on startup that a used had with integrated intel graphics card

Potential crash fix when adding actors to crowd
